content: 2026 multi-agent orchestration consensus pattern: each parallel agent gets its own git worktree (own directory+branch+working state) created at task spawn from a frozen copy of the default branch, avoiding stash/collision problems. A non-LLM coordinator (plain workflow engine) owns reconciliation -- waits for terminal agent status, reads the diff, decides merge/retry, never auto-merges blindly. Tools in this space: Conductor, Vibe Kanban, Claude Squad, Gastown, Cursor Background Agents; Claude Code natively supports CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS=1 for a lead+teammates model sharing a task list.
